title: centaurea cuneifolia subsp. sublanata
intro: Centaurea cuneifolia subsp. sublanata, commonly known as the Mountain Bladder Knapweed, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may aid in wound healing and the management of certain infections. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Bladder Knapweed are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. Further research is necessary to fully understand the effects and potential applications of this plant species.
